_comment: Move pool. category: physical (Atk vs Def) / special (SpA vs SpD) / status (no damage). pp = max Power Points. priority: higher acts first regardless of Speed (default 0). multiHit: [minHits, maxHits] — fixed count when min===max (e.g. a Twineedle-style 2-hit move), otherwise rolled per the mainline 2/3/4/5-hit odds (37.5/37.5/12.5/12.5%); power is the PER-HIT value, and the effect (if any) resolves once after the whole sequence, not per hit. recoil: fraction of the damage just dealt, dealt back to the attacker (Take Down/Double-Edge/Submission/Volt Tackle-style), regardless of whether the target fainted. ohko: true deals damage equal to the target's current HP on a hit (Fissure/Sheer Cold-style) — accuracy stays a flat approximation rather than the real level-difference formula. fixedDamage: 'level' (= attacker's level), 'halfHP' (= target's current HP, halved), or a flat number — bypasses Atk/Def/STAB/crit entirely (Seismic Toss/Night Shade/Sonic Boom/Dragon Rage/Super Fang-style) but a 0x type immunity still blocks it. neverFaint: true never brings the target below 1 HP (False Swipe-style). selfKO: true faints the attacker after the move resolves, no matter whether it hit, missed, or was blocked (Explosion/Self-Destruct-style). weatherBall: true on a move swaps its effective type (and doubles its power) to match the active weather — Fire in sun, Water in rain, Ice in hail, Rock in sandstorm, plain Normal at half power with no weather up. effect may combine: { status, volatile ('confusion'|'flinch'|'seed' — Leech Seed-style, Grass-types immune, drains 1/8 max HP to the opposing side each turn), stages {stat:delta}, target ('self'|'foe'), chance (default 100), heal (fraction of the healer's own max HP), drain (fraction of the damage just dealt, healed to the attacker — Absorb/Giga Drain-style, skipped if the hit fainted the target), clearHazards (Rapid Spin-style, clears the user's own side), bellyDrum (Belly Drum-style: spends half the user's max HP to set Attack straight to +6, fails if it can't afford the cost), weather ('rain'|'sun'|'sandstorm'|'hail', 5 turns, field-wide — Rain/Sun boost their own type 1.5x and halve the other; Sandstorm/Hail chip 1/16 max HP each turn on non-immune types), screen ('reflect'|'lightScreen', 5 turns on the caster's side, halves incoming physical/special damage respectively — critical hits bypass it) }. Self-targeted stage moves never miss. The large block below is an original moveset covering the same breadth/roles as classic Gen 1 (one counterpart per slot: nukes, status spreaders, stat dancers, flinchers, etc.), with names echoing the originals' feel without copying them, and secondary effects trimmed to what this engine actually models (no charge-turn/recharge/Substitute/forced-switch/move-restriction — those mechanics aren't implemented, so equivalents are approximated or simplified; a few outlier power values are dampened to compensate for missing drawbacks like recharge). The final block (after volt_cannon) does the same for Gen 3 (Ruby/Sapphire/Emerald)'s new movepool: unsupported mechanics (held items, multi-turn charge/recharge, stat-scaling-by-HP, ability copying, delayed hits) are approximated as a flat power/accuracy adjustment or the closest supported effect instead.

split_fate.flavor: Ties the user's fate to the target's, pooling their combined HP and splitting it evenly between them.

doom_chant.name: Doom Chant
doom_chant.flavor: An ominous chant that seems to slow time itself for the target.

snow_puff.name: Snow Puff
snow_puff.flavor: A light flurry of packed snow.

wrapped_gift.name: Wrapped Gift
wrapped_gift.flavor: An unpredictable parcel that could hold almost anything.

guard_stance.name: Guard Stance
guard_stance.flavor: Braces against literally anything for the turn — grows less reliable if used again right away.

mind_sync.name: Mind Sync
mind_sync.flavor: Matches the target's rhythm and turns it to its own advantage.

shadow_chase.name: Shadow Chase
shadow_chase.flavor: A relentless pursuit that catches the target off guard.

downpour.name: Downpour
downpour.flavor: Calls up a soothing rain that settles over the whole field.

quick_spin.name: Quick Spin
quick_spin.flavor: A fast, spinning strike that shakes off any clutter scattered on the user's side of the field.

loyal_strike.name: Loyal Strike
loyal_strike.flavor: A strike thrown with everything a devoted creature has to give.

last_stand.name: Last Stand
last_stand.flavor: A final, all-in effort thrown against the odds.

smash_blow.name: Smash Blow
smash_blow.flavor: A rough blow that can crack through solid defenses.

tumble_strike.name: Tumble Strike
tumble_strike.flavor: Curls up and barrels straight into the target.

holy_flame.name: Holy Flame
holy_flame.flavor: A searing flame said to purify whatever it touches.

ward_charm.name: Ward Charm
ward_charm.flavor: Wraps the user in a quiet, protective charm.

grit_storm.name: Grit Storm
grit_storm.flavor: Kicks up a stinging swirl of grit and dust that rages across the whole field.

fright_mask.name: Fright Mask
fright_mask.flavor: A menacing expression that roots the target in place.

phantom_orb.name: Phantom Orb
phantom_orb.flavor: A sphere of dense shadow thrown straight through the target's guard.

quick_study.name: Quick Study
quick_study.flavor: Studies an opponent's technique closely enough to borrow from it.

drowsy_mutter.name: Drowsy Mutter
drowsy_mutter.flavor: A mumbled, half-conscious mutter that somehow steadies the body.

toxic_bomb.name: Toxic Bomb
toxic_bomb.flavor: A dense glob of caustic sludge.

sleepy_roar.name: Sleepy Roar
sleepy_roar.flavor: A low, droning roar that can catch the target off guard.

jolt_tackle.name: Jolt Tackle
jolt_tackle.flavor: A full-body tackle crackling with static.

web_trap.name: Web Trap
web_trap.flavor: Coats the target's feet in fine, clinging webbing, trapping it in place.

caltrops.name: Caltrops
caltrops.flavor: Scatters sharp caltrops on the ground that jab any creature sent out on this side of the field. Flying creatures are unaffected.

grudge_whisper.name: Grudge Whisper
grudge_whisper.flavor: A bitter whisper that lingers and saps resolve.

iron_wing.name: Iron Wing
iron_wing.flavor: A gleaming wing strike that can toughen the user's hide.

clear_skies.name: Clear Skies
clear_skies.flavor: Clears the clouds overhead, letting harsh sunlight blaze down on the whole field.

taunting_grin.name: Taunting Grin
taunting_grin.flavor: A goading grin that pumps up the target's Attack but rattles its focus.

petal_kiss.name: Petal Kiss
petal_kiss.flavor: A sweet, disarming kiss that leaves the target dizzy.

honeyed_air.name: Honeyed Air
honeyed_air.flavor: A cloying scent that makes the target easy to track.

photosynth.name: Photosynth
photosynth.flavor: Draws in ambient light, recovering half the user's max HP.

triad_kick.name: Triad Kick
triad_kick.flavor: Three fast kicks thrown in one motion.

whirl_gust.name: Whirl Gust
whirl_gust.flavor: A spinning gust that can catch the target off balance.

sure_throw.name: Sure Throw
sure_throw.flavor: A slow, deliberate throw that never misses its mark.

vortex_grip.name: Vortex Grip
vortex_grip.flavor: A tight, spiraling current of water.

volt_cannon.name: Volt Cannon
volt_cannon.flavor: An overloaded blast of electricity that locks up whatever it hits.

sudden_jolt.name: Sudden Jolt
sudden_jolt.flavor: A startling opening strike thrown before the foe can react.

rowdy_din.name: Rowdy Din
rowdy_din.flavor: An overwhelming clamor that drowns out everything else.

brace_stack.name: Brace Stack
brace_stack.flavor: Squares up and settles into a sturdier stance.

unleash.name: Unleash
unleash.flavor: Releases everything the user has been holding back in one burst.

settle_down.name: Settle Down
settle_down.flavor: Takes a moment to steady itself, mending a good portion of its wounds.

scorch_gale.name: Scorch Gale
scorch_gale.flavor: A wave of superheated air rolling outward from the user.

chill_front.name: Chill Front
chill_front.flavor: Calls in a biting cold snap that blankets the whole field in hail.

goad.name: Goad
goad.flavor: Gets under the target's skin, throwing off its offensive rhythm.

sweet_talk.name: Sweet Talk
sweet_talk.flavor: Empty praise that puffs the target up even as it muddles its thinking.

haunting_flame.name: Haunting Flame
haunting_flame.flavor: A ghostly flicker of fire that clings to whatever it touches, burning it.

parting_blow.name: Parting Blow
parting_blow.flavor: A harsh farewell aimed squarely at the target's confidence.

stubborn_hit.name: Stubborn Hit
stubborn_hit.flavor: A defiant strike thrown with more grit than finesse.

braced_haymaker.name: Braced Haymaker
braced_haymaker.flavor: A heavily telegraphed haymaker that lands last but hits like a truck.

sharp_snap.name: Sharp Snap
sharp_snap.flavor: A jarring strike meant to shake the target back to its senses.

over_here.name: Over Here
over_here.flavor: Draws attention to the user and braces for whatever comes of it.

borrowed_force.name: Borrowed Force
borrowed_force.flavor: Calls upon whatever's nearby to lend a hand, for better or worse.

static_prep.name: Static Prep
static_prep.flavor: Builds up a store of current, toughening the user's resolve for what's next.

provoke.name: Provoke
provoke.flavor: Baits the target into dropping its guard.

quick_assist.name: Quick Assist
quick_assist.flavor: A hurried show of support that sharpens the user's focus.

sleight.name: Sleight
sleight.flavor: A quick switcheroo that leaves the target looking the wrong way.

mirror_stance.name: Mirror Stance
mirror_stance.flavor: Mimics the target's fighting style, picking up a measure of its poise.

quiet_hope.name: Quiet Hope
quiet_hope.flavor: A moment of stillness that mends the user's wounds.

called_favor.name: Called Favor
called_favor.flavor: Calls out for help and lands wherever the timing works out.

root_down.name: Root Down
root_down.flavor: Puts down roots, drawing a steady trickle of nourishment from the earth.

overexert.name: Overexert
overexert.flavor: An all-out effort that leaves the user's form a little worse for wear.

ward_mirror.name: Ward Mirror
ward_mirror.flavor: Raises a reflective ward for the turn — grows less reliable if used again right away.

reclaim.name: Reclaim
reclaim.flavor: Gathers up whatever was left behind and puts it to use again.

comeback.name: Comeback
comeback.flavor: A patient strike that lands dead last but carries a grudge's worth of force.

karate_split.name: Karate Split
karate_split.flavor: A hard, flat-palmed strike aimed at whatever stands in the way.

heavy_lids.name: Heavy Lids
heavy_lids.flavor: A deep, contagious drowsiness that settles over the target.

strip_down.name: Strip Down
strip_down.flavor: A rough, disarming swipe aimed at whatever the target's holding onto.

even_the_odds.name: Even the Odds
even_the_odds.flavor: Grinds the fight down to a stalemate of raw endurance.

blowup.name: Blow-Up
blowup.flavor: An explosive release that's most devastating while the user's still at full strength.

trade_edge.name: Trade Edge
trade_edge.flavor: Trades away a piece of the target's instinct for something borrowed.

lockstep.name: Lockstep
lockstep.flavor: Falls into a guarded rhythm that's hard to pin down.

steady_breath.name: Steady Breath
steady_breath.flavor: A slow, deliberate breath that settles the body and mends it a little.

last_word.name: Last Word
last_word.flavor: A bitter parting shot that lingers long after it's spoken.

quickstep.name: Quickstep
quickstep.flavor: A sudden sidestep that repositions the user before anything else happens.

hidden_jolt.name: Hidden Jolt
hidden_jolt.flavor: An attack that draws on whatever the surroundings offer, with unpredictable results.

plunge.name: Plunge
plunge.flavor: A sudden dive that carries the user's full weight into the target.

elbow_flurry.name: Elbow Flurry
elbow_flurry.flavor: A rapid series of jabbing elbow strikes, landing two to five times.

blend_in.name: Blend In
blend_in.flavor: Adapts to the surroundings, settling into a sturdier posture.

lantern_flare.name: Lantern Flare
lantern_flare.flavor: A brilliant glow that sharpens the user's focus to a fine point.

radiant_burst.name: Radiant Burst
radiant_burst.flavor: An intense flash of psychic light that can wear down the target's composure.

haze_orb.name: Haze Orb
haze_orb.flavor: A drifting orb of fog that can cloud the target's focus.

plume_veil.name: Plume Veil
plume_veil.flavor: A drifting cloud of soft feathers that saps the target's aggression.

reel_dance.name: Reel Dance
reel_dance.flavor: A dizzying dance that leaves onlookers stumbling.

ember_heel.name: Ember Heel
ember_heel.flavor: A precise kick wreathed in flame.

mud_veil.name: Mud Veil
mud_veil.flavor: Slings mud across the field, making the user harder to pin down.

frost_orb.name: Frost Orb
frost_orb.flavor: A packed ball of ice hurled with a spinning wind-up.

thorn_arm.name: Thorn Arm
thorn_arm.flavor: A thorn-studded swing that may catch the target off guard.

ease_up.name: Ease Up
ease_up.flavor: Takes it easy for a moment, mending a good portion of its wounds.

booming_call.name: Booming Call
booming_call.flavor: A thunderous shout that rattles everything nearby.

venom_tooth.name: Venom Tooth
venom_tooth.flavor: A deep bite that can leave a worsening venom behind.

rend_claw.name: Rend Claw
rend_claw.flavor: A powerful claw strike that can crack through the target's guard.

cataclysm_flame.name: Cataclysm Flame
cataclysm_flame.flavor: An earth-scorching eruption of fire thrown with everything the user has.

deluge_cannon.name: Deluge Cannon
deluge_cannon.flavor: A cannon-blast of water unleashed with everything the user has.

falling_star_fist.name: Falling Star Fist
falling_star_fist.flavor: A crashing punch that can leave the user emboldened.

spook.name: Spook
spook.flavor: A sudden, unsettling jolt that can catch the target off guard.

skyborne_orb.name: Skyborne Orb
skyborne_orb.flavor: A drifting orb of gathered energy, taking on the type and force of whatever weather is in the air.

soothing_bouquet.name: Soothing Bouquet
soothing_bouquet.flavor: A calming fragrance that drifts through the whole party, curing every status ailment.

crocodile_tears.name: Crocodile Tears
crocodile_tears.flavor: A hollow display of sorrow that leaves the target's guard down.

razor_gale.name: Razor Gale
razor_gale.flavor: A spinning gust with edges sharp enough to cut.

meltdown.name: Meltdown
meltdown.flavor: An all-consuming blast of heat that leaves the user's own fire spent.

keen_scent.name: Keen Scent
keen_scent.flavor: Sniffs out exactly where the target's hiding, stripping away its tricks.

stone_cage.name: Stone Cage
stone_cage.flavor: Buries the target's feet under tumbling stone.

glinting_gust.name: Glinting Gust
glinting_gust.flavor: A shimmering gust of fine dust that can lift every stat at once.

grating_screech.name: Grating Screech
grating_screech.flavor: An awful metallic screech that rattles the target's composure.

reed_pipe.name: Reed Pipe
reed_pipe.flavor: A soft, breathy tune played on a hollow reed.

pester.name: Pester
pester.flavor: An irritating, giggling nuisance that saps the target's composure and guard.

starlit_focus.name: Starlit Focus
starlit_focus.flavor: Draws on distant starlight, steadying the body on every side.

geyser_burst.name: Geyser Burst
geyser_burst.flavor: A towering column of water, most devastating while the user's still at full strength.

pulse_ray.name: Pulse Ray
pulse_ray.flavor: A flickering beam of erratic energy that may confuse the target.

void_fist.name: Void Fist
void_fist.flavor: A punch thrown from someplace the target can't quite see.

mind_flash.name: Mind Flash
mind_flash.flavor: A sudden pulse of psychic force that can catch the target off guard.

rising_fist.name: Rising Fist
rising_fist.flavor: An uppercut thrown hard enough to catch even an airborne target.

dune_grip.name: Dune Grip
dune_grip.flavor: Buries the target in shifting sand, pinning it in place.

absolute_zero.name: Absolute Zero
absolute_zero.flavor: A single strike of cold so extreme it can end the fight outright.

silt_wave.name: Silt Wave
silt_wave.flavor: A churning wave of muddy water that can blur the target's vision.

seed_volley.name: Seed Volley
seed_volley.flavor: A rapid volley of hard-shelled seeds, two to five in a row.

wind_slash.name: Wind Slash
wind_slash.flavor: A precise slashing strike carried on the wind.

ice_lance_volley.name: Ice Lance Volley
ice_lance_volley.flavor: A rapid volley of sharpened ice shards, two to five in a row.

plate_up.name: Plate Up
plate_up.flavor: Hardens the body like plated armor, sharply raising Defense.

cut_off.name: Cut Off
cut_off.flavor: Cuts off every route of escape.

rallying_cry.name: Rallying Cry
rallying_cry.flavor: A rallying cry that steels the user's resolve.

rootquake.name: Rootquake
rootquake.flavor: A violent eruption of roots torn straight from the earth.

harden_up.name: Harden Up
harden_up.flavor: Tenses every muscle, building both strength and sturdiness.

skyhop.name: Skyhop
skyhop.flavor: A springing leap that comes down hard on the target.

silt_spurt.name: Silt Spurt
silt_spurt.flavor: A quick spurt of heavy mud that can bog the target down.

venom_lash.name: Venom Lash
venom_lash.flavor: A whip-fast strike tipped with venom.

grabby_swipe.name: Grabby Swipe
grabby_swipe.flavor: An opportunistic swipe thrown with an eye for anything left unguarded.

overcharge_ram.name: Overcharge Ram
overcharge_ram.flavor: A reckless, crackling charge that risks a jolt right back at the user.

glimmer_leaf.name: Glimmer Leaf
glimmer_leaf.flavor: A softly glowing leaf that curves to find its mark.

splash_veil.name: Splash Veil
splash_veil.flavor: Douses the user in water, softening the next hit it takes.

still_waters.name: Still Waters
still_waters.flavor: A deep, meditative calm that sharpens the mind on every front.

keen_leaf.name: Keen Leaf
keen_leaf.flavor: A single, razor-edged leaf swung with surgical precision.

wyrm_waltz.name: Wyrm Waltz
wyrm_waltz.flavor: A ritual dance said to stir a dragon's blood, sharpening both strength and speed.

stone_volley.name: Stone Volley
stone_volley.flavor: A rapid volley of jagged stones, two to five in a row.

current_snap.name: Current Snap
current_snap.flavor: A sharp pulse of current that's nearly impossible to dodge.

ripple_pulse.name: Ripple Pulse
ripple_pulse.flavor: A pulsing ring of water that can leave the target disoriented.

fated_strike.name: Fated Strike
fated_strike.flavor: A premeditated strike, aimed and set in motion well before it lands.

mind_shatter.name: Mind Shatter
mind_shatter.flavor: An overwhelming psychic overload that leaves the user's own mind reeling.
